title: Capital Structure document-term parse receipt
description: Operational evidence that one manifest/content/parser-version parse completed and materialized during a compile. It only exempts an already-parsed filing from being re-read and re-parsed on a later nightly run. It is not a fact, never amends or re-versions the append-only observation ledger, and grants no capacity, signal, sizing, or Prophet authority.

receipt_id.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of [source_manifest_id, content_sha256, parser_version].

parser_implementation_sha256.description: The released registry's implementation digest for parser_version.

candidate_logical_ids_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the sorted candidate logical_observation_id list.

candidate_semantic_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of [[logical_observation_id, semantic body], ...] sorted by logical id.
